key_findings: CCI reduces MeCP2 and Kir4.1 expression selectively in spinal dorsal horn astrocytes; astrocytic MeCP2 knockdown reduces Kir4.1 and causes hyperalgesia.

Astrocyte-specific Kir4.1 loss depolarizes astrocytes, increases tonic firing of lamina I-II neurons and causes hyperalgesia, while Kir4.1 or MeCP2 overexpression in spinal astrocytes relieves CCI hyperalgesia.
